title: DarGlobal company overview
text: DarGlobal (Dar Global PLC) is a London-listed international luxury real estate developer and the international arm of Saudi developer Dar Al Arkan, which set it up in 2017. It focuses on high-end branded residences and mixed-use developments, often with global brands such as the Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Lamborghini, Pagani, Missoni, Elie Saab, W Hotels and Mouawad. Its portfolio includes villas and apartments, co-branded residences and off-plan properties. Projects span the UAE, Oman, Qatar, the UK, Spain and Saudi Arabia, with about US$7.5 billion of projects under development according to company statements reported in the press.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah (DarGlobal)
text: Trump Tower Jeddah is DarGlobal's first Trump-branded project in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, unveiled in December 2024 as a luxury residential tower with high-end apartments. On 26 November 2025 DarGlobal awarded the main works contract to Arabian Construction Company (ACC), after enabling and foundation works were completed; the contract was reported as about SAR 2 billion (roughly US$532 million). Press reports give differing headline project values (US$530 million in some, US$1 billion in others).

title: Trump Plaza Jeddah (DarGlobal)
text: Trump Plaza Jeddah is DarGlobal's second collaboration with the Trump Organization in Jeddah, announced as a plan in September 2025 and launched in January 2026 as an estimated US$1 billion mixed-use development. It is to include executive and premium residences, serviced apartments, Grade-A office space, exclusive townhouses, home offices, retail and curated dining, anchored by a Central Park-inspired green spine.

title: DarGlobal in Riyadh and new Saudi land
text: In January 2026 DarGlobal unveiled the first of two Trump-branded projects planned for Riyadh: the Trump International Golf Club in Wadi Safar, covering 2.6 million square metres. DarGlobal also announced Saudi land acquisitions in Jeddah and Riyadh totalling about US$390 million. In November 2026 The National reported a new mixed-use development in Jeddah valued at about SAR 1 billion (US$267 million).

title: DarGlobal Dubai and UAE projects
text: DarGlobal is developing Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai, a roughly US$1 billion tower on Sheikh Zayed Road; the enabling works contract was awarded to Edrafor Emirates LLC on 10 December 2025. In the UAE it also launched The Astera (US$238 million) on Al Marjan Island, with Aston Martin-designed interiors and an exclusive Sky Villa (US$11 million) in its 1 of 1 portfolio. Other Aston Martin and W Residences branded projects are in the UAE.

title: DarGlobal Oman and Spain projects
text: In Oman, DarGlobal's Aida development in Muscat includes Trump International Oman (resort, golf club and residences), The Great Escape 2 (US$70 million residential complex) and Marriott Residences (US$100 million beachfront). In Spain, Tierra Viva is a collection of 53 villas near Marbella developed with Automobili Lamborghini.

title: DarGlobal 2024 launches
text: In January 2025 DarGlobal said it had launched ten luxury projects in 2024 across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman and Spain with a combined value above US$1.9 billion, and was planning expansion into the United States in 2025.

title: DarGlobal projects in Saudi Arabia (summary)
text: DarGlobal's Saudi Arabia projects: Trump Tower Jeddah (unveiled December 2024, main works awarded to Arabian Construction Company in November 2025); Trump Plaza Jeddah (launched January 2026, est. US$1 billion mixed-use development); Trump International Golf Club in Wadi Safar, Riyadh (2.6 million sqm, launched January 2026, the first of two Trump-branded Riyadh projects); a new SAR 1 billion mixed-use development in Jeddah reported in November 2026; and land acquisitions in Jeddah and Riyadh totalling about US$390 million.
